items.name: Soothing Tonic
items.description: A weak but stable draught made from restorative residue.

effects.description: Gives a lighter restorative lift.

items.name: Lantern Leak
items.description: An unstable glow brew that still sheds useful light.

effects.description: Casts a short-lived lantern aura.

items.name: Rush Draught
items.description: A rough stimulant salvaged from aggressive ingredients.

effects.description: Adds a brief burst of hurried motion.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: A reliable restorative made from common valley herbs.

effects.description: Restores the body and steadies the nerves.

items.name: Glow Potion
items.description: A shimmering draft that illuminates dark paths.

effects.description: Bathes the drinker in a pale lantern aura.

items.name: Star Lantern Elixir
items.description: A refined luminous brew with long-lasting crystalline glow.

effects.description: Creates a steadier lantern aura with little loss.
Sharpens movement through dark routes.

items.name: Beastcalm Extract
items.description: A quieting extract used to settle tower creatures and skittish magical fauna.

effects.description: Gives a soft halo that keeps habitats calm.

items.name: Splash Glow Potion
items.description: A glow potion rewritten to burst outward in a quick halo.

effects.description: Releases a wider lantern bloom on use.

items.name: Echo Healing Draught
items.description: A healing draught with a softer second pulse worked into it.

effects.description: Restores more vitality in an echoed wave.

items.name: Delayed Stamina Tonic
items.description: A stamina tonic held in reserve before it surges through the body.

effects.description: Builds into a longer, steadier rush.

items.name: Stamina Tonic
items.description: A sharp tonic that steadies breath and motion.

effects.description: Quickens movement and lightens the body.

items.name: Murky Concoction
items.description: The sort of result that explains why labels matter.

effects.description: A clinging magical residue that leaves you sluggish.

items.name: Field Poultice
items.description: A rough sun-and-meadow salve that closes up the scrapes a work crew earns in a day.

effects.description: Eases minor hurts and takes the sting out of tired hands.

items.name: Calmleaf Infusion
items.description: A quiet green infusion brewed for people who have forgotten how to sleep.

effects.description: Loosens a clenched jaw and lets a racing head settle.

items.name: Verdant Restorative
items.description: A deep-green tonic that coaxes vigor back into tired bodies and tired beds alike.

effects.description: Restores a solid measure of vitality and steadies growth.

items.name: Bloomrise Elixir
items.description: A refined restorative that wakes dormant roots and thin bodies in one long green pulse.

effects.description: Pours a lasting bloom of vitality into whatever drinks it.

items.name: Greenmend Salve
items.description: A cool, clean salve tuned for wilted planter beds and delicate specimens.

effects.description: Feeds tired roots and settles skittish growth.

items.name: Lantern Draught
items.description: A humble glow brew that keeps a road lamp honest through the early dark.

effects.description: Holds a steady working light for a short while.

items.name: Mothlight Brew
items.description: A soft, drifting glow gathered from settled moth dust, kind to night eyes.

effects.description: Casts a gentle, long-carrying light for night gathering.

items.name: Wardlight Solution
items.description: A cold arcane light meant to read faded wards and half-erased sigils.

effects.description: Throws a clear, revealing light across worn magical stone.

items.name: Runemark Elixir
items.description: A refined wardlight that makes old inscriptions surface as if freshly cut.

effects.description: Sustains a bright revealing glow across faded runework.

items.name: Duskbell Tonic
items.description: A calm, dim glow brewed to keep dusk-shy creatures settled while they are handled.

effects.description: Casts a soft halo that keeps nervous creatures calm.

items.name: Trailblaze Tonic
items.description: A hot desert-and-ember tonic that keeps repair crews moving through a long shift.

effects.description: Drives a strong, sustained push of energy.

items.name: Wildfire Draught
items.description: A fierce overcharged stimulant that should be handed out with a warning.

effects.description: Unleashes a hard, long-burning surge of speed.

items.name: Sunwarden Tonic
items.description: A warming tonic that steadies the body against desert heat and long exposed roads.

effects.description: Keeps footing sure and warm across hard ground.

items.name: Briskstep Draught
items.description: A gentle, well-mannered pick-me-up for elders and anyone who dislikes a jolt.

effects.description: Lends a light, even quickness with no rough edge.

items.name: Purified Draught
items.description: A clean, exacting restorative prized by buyers who pay for a flawless pour.

effects.description: Restores vitality with an unusually clean finish.

items.name: Wellspring Elixir
items.description: A masterwork-grade restorative, the sort of pour a town remembers.

effects.description: Floods the body with clean, lasting vitality.

items.name: Emberglass Tonic
items.description: A warm amber light hardened with quarry minerals, steady in wind and heat.

effects.description: Holds a warm, wind-resistant working light.

items.name: Stargrove Elixir
items.description: A layered luminous elixir that blends grove-cool and arcane light into one clear beam.

effects.description: Sustains a strong, clear light for deep or dark spaces.

items.name: Celestine Elixir
items.description: The observatory's own light: a crystalline glow that also sharpens the step beneath it.

effects.description: Creates a long, brilliant, near-lossless lantern aura.
Steadies and quickens movement through dark routes.

items.name: Moonmoth Salve
items.description: A restorative that leaves a faint moth-light halo, easy on frightened patients at night.

effects.description: Restores vitality with a calming glow.
Sheds a brief, soothing light.

items.name: Kindling Tonic
items.description: A warm hearth-tonic that puts heat back into cold hands on an autumn morning.

effects.description: Restores warmth and a little vigor against the cold.

items.name: Sunscar Glass Elixir
items.description: Night bloom and noon resin held in one bottle: a light that carries desert heat without burning down.

effects.description: Throws a wide, warm light that shrugs off wind and cold alike.

items.name: Nightglass Lantern
items.description: The desert's own lantern. Starlight settles the mixture until the glass keeps a cold, tireless flame.

effects.description: Holds a cold, near-inexhaustible light through a whole night route.
Eases the chill that comes with walking the dunes after dark.

items.name: Mirrorsalt Draught
items.description: Salt-pan flake cut with reedflower, clean enough that the town's water carriers drink it straight.

effects.description: Restores vitality and clears the grit of a long dry route.
